purpose: Stage-2 G2: freeze how n-insertion candidate occurrences join sense (A2), etymology and frequency (A3) variables. Joins preserve uncertainty as status columns; nothing is dropped or auto-resolved. No execution is authorized by this contract (G3 onward requires separate GO).

sense_a2.file_layout: one CSV per session file id (utt_id prefix before first dot), schema: utt_id, word_idx, morph_idx, morph, tag, sense_id, confidence, method, candidates

join_key.verified: 26/26 left+right positions of 13 boundary rows (session SDRW2000000001, 2020) matched A2 rows including surface and tag; probe 2026-08-18

sense_a2.integrity_guard: joined A2 row must equal candidate {side}_morph_surface and {side}_pos; on inequality record status, never substitute values

trust_rules.rule: MFS-based sense assignments are analysis references, never final per-token senses for polysemous targets; ambiguous/not_found are preserved as-is. Per METHODS_bareun_dialogue_reanalysis.md trust map.
trust_rules.note_not_target: A2 assigns no sense to J*/E*/S* tags; candidate right morphemes already exclude J*/E* by the frozen query, left morphemes may legitimately be joined_not_target

etym_freq_a3.etym_type_empty_handling: empty etym_type is preserved and reported as etym_unknown in derived class, not imputed

trust_rules.freq_columns: corpus freq_* counts are top-trust primary variables; external norms (MP/LS/ML2025/KoFREN) are comparison references
trust_rules.etym_origin: conditional trust, auto-reanalysis artifacts possible (candidate lists like 勵行|厲行|女行); reference-only, never a filter

derived_boundary_etym_class.rule: from left/right etym_type: sino_internal_candidate (intra_eojeol AND both 한자어), native_compound_candidate (both 고유어), mixed, loan_involved, etym_unknown (any side empty or not_in_dictionary)
derived_boundary_etym_class.resolves: etym_check_needed from G1 (sino-Korean internal inclusion decision)
derived_boundary_etym_class.finality: derived class is a routing aid; researcher confirms class membership for analysis, especially sino_internal_candidate

sense_freq_a3b.usage: optional analysis join after sense is settled per token
sense_freq_a3b.trust_rules: corpus freq_YYYY for polysemous items inherits MFS bias; for sense-specific frequency prefer independent freq_LS_spoken/freq_LS_all columns per METHODS trust map

eojeol_freq_second_stage.path_rule: candidate (utt_id, {side}_eojeol_idx) -> orth/eojeol token table surface -> eojeol_freq_dictionary.eojeol
eojeol_freq_second_stage.status: documented for the analysis stage; not part of the G3/G4 candidate build

required_reports: sense join rate by join_status and by sense_method, separately for left and right sides
etym join rate and etym_type distribution incl. empty share
zero-drop accounting: candidate rows in == candidate rows out, statuses only
fail_conditions: any candidate row dropped by a join
any morph_tag_mismatch silently treated as joined
audit counts not reproducible by independent re-scan

validation_evidence.headers_verified: morpheme/eojeol/sense freq dictionary headers and A2 session file header measured on disk 2026-08-18
